summary.plain: The team, led from ETH Zurich and CIEMAT, that built and ran the ArDM liquid argon dark matter detector, first at CERN and then in the Canfranc underground laboratory in Spain.
summary.technical: ArDM Collaboration (papers of 2013-2018 list ETH Zurich, CIEMAT and CERN PH/DT authors); developed the detector at CERN as Recognised Experiment RE18 and ran it at LSC as EXP-08-2010. One of the four founding projects of the Global Argon Dark Matter Collaboration. No roster or member count was recorded.
